name: Graham Faulkner
bio:
Graham Faulkner's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly. After a solid career in corporate accounting, a chance encounter at a local racing event ignited a passion he never knew he had. He traded spreadsheets for speed, bringing his meticulous financial acumen to the high-octane world of racing. Graham believes in a data-driven approach, ensuring every dollar spent maximizes performance on and off the track.

At Allied Racing, Graham is known for his calm demeanor and ability to navigate complex financial landscapes. He prioritizes fiscal responsibility without stifling innovation, finding the sweet spot where financial stability fuels competitive advantage. What sets Graham apart is his practical, hands-on approach; he understands the intricacies of the sport, from engine development to logistical costs, ensuring financial decisions are grounded in racing realities.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a slightly weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn calculator in his pocket.
Insists on reviewing every invoice personally, no matter how small.
Has a lucky pen he uses for signing all financial documents.
